plain: The official banning or outlawing of people

webster.text: The act of proscribing or dooming to death; among the Romans, the public offer of a reward for the head of a political enemy.

more.text: A putting out of the protection of law; condemning to exile.

example.quote: And our fathers were particularly the objects of the persecutions and proscriptions of the times.
example.cite: John Adams, A Dissertation on the Canon and the Feudal Law (1765)
